actions.name: Move
actions.description: If partnered, characters move as a pair, following the pattern of the dance. If unpartnered, characters move independently.

actions.name: Probe Secret
actions.description:
Gain a token from the supply, based on the following rules:
Adjacent to an ally: gain Wits or Instructions.
Adjacent to an enemy: gain Gossip or Blackmail.
Adjacent to an NPC: gain a rumor.

actions.name: Tell Tales
actions.description: If adjacent to an enemy, they gain a chatter token, or a misinformation token if they're next to another of your allies.
